name: Hungry Pockets
description: HungryPockets is a European streetwear shop whose positioning centers on the phrase "Always Starving Since 2014" and the idea of an official uniform for people driven to keep growing.
summary: Hungry Pockets presents itself as a streetwear brand founded in 2014 around a chest-pocket symbol and an always-hungry mindset. The homepage describes the brand as "the official uniform of the hustle" and links to men’s and women’s collections, latest drops, a Hustle Journal, Instagram, TikTok, and Pinterest. The manifesto expands the positioning into urban, effort-oriented language: hunger means drive rather than lack, with references to early gym sessions, late-night coding, skating practice, protection, utility, and "urban armor." The site uses a dark black/white visual system with red highlights and Oswald typography. Product pages and the shop are linked from the homepage, but this record does not infer unverified product claims beyond the visible site copy.

brand.name: HUNGRY POCKETS
brand.voice: Direct, defiant, energetic, compact, and motivational. Use concrete hustle language without sounding corporate. Keep the tone streetwear-editorial and focused on drive, growth, utility, and self-direction.
brand.audience: People drawn to streetwear and an ambition-led urban lifestyle, including people who identify with persistent training, creative work, coding, skating, and personal growth.

pages.title: HungryPockets — Always Starving Since 2014 — HungryPockets
pages.text: Always Starving Since 2014. The official uniform of the hustle. Shop the drop. The manifesto. Homepage copy says the idea is a chest pocket representing pure hustle and the mindset is Always Starving. It features latest drops and most wanted products, including Five Panel Cap, Dad hat, Women’s crop top, Unisex windbreaker, Brand Oversized faded t-shirt, Oversized faded t-shirt, Cuffed Beanie, and camisa curta homem preta. It links to Men, Women, New Arrivals, Limited Drops, The Manifesto, Hustle Journal, Instagram (https://instagram.com/hungrypockets), TikTok (https://tiktok.com/@hungrypockets), and Pinterest (https://pinterest.com/hungrypockets). Footer positioning: Always starving since 2014. The evolution of the pocket. Crafted for those who never stop. A newsletter invitation says Join the circle. Get early access to drops. Source HTML exposes Oswald from Google Fonts and CSS tokens including --bg:#111111, --panel:#1a1a1a, --text:#f5f5f5, --muted:#a3a3a3, --red:#e63946, --line:#ffffff14, and --accent:#e63946, with a light-theme variant using --bg:#ffffff, --panel:#f2f2f2, --text:#111111, and --muted:#555555.

pages.title: The Pocket Manifesto — HungryPockets
pages.text: The Pocket Manifesto. Always starving since 2014. Origin: It all started in 2014. Not in a boardroom, but on the concrete. Hungry Pockets wasn't conceived as a brand, but as a statement. The idea was simple: a chest pocket representing the hunger for more. More growth, more success, more life. Mentality: Always Starving isn't about lack; it's about drive. It's the 5 AM gym session. It's the midnight code. It's the skate trick perfected on the 100th fall. Our gear is the official uniform for those who refuse to be full. Evolution: 2026 is the year we stop just having pockets and start being the pocket. Protection, utility, and pure urban armor. Quote: If your pockets are full, you've stopped growing. Stay hungry. Stay Hungry. The page links to Shop the drop and the same official Instagram, TikTok, and Pinterest profiles.

warnings: The official homepage HTML links Oswald from Google Fonts and uses Oswald in its inline styling; the record therefore uses Oswald for both headingFont and bodyFont. The owner instruction explicitly requires uppercase Oswald headlines.

Exact CSS tokens observed in the homepage/manifesto HTML include #111111 background, #f5f5f5 text, #e63946 red primary/accent, #1a1a1a panel, and #a3a3a3 muted text. The secondary blue #2563eb is an owner-specified occasional accent override, not an exact site CSS token observed in the fetched HTML.
The four templates are editorial concepts based only on verified homepage and manifesto language. They avoid unverified customer claims, promotions, availability, shipping claims, and prices.

The product preview assets are linked by the official homepage from files.cdn.printful.com and were downloaded as exact original response bytes; they are retained only as original linked project media.
No generic stock imagery was downloaded. No video asset was downloaded; the Video template uses an original site image as its visual reference and requires motion treatment in the social planner.

name: SwiftDisplay
description: SwiftDisplay is a Portuguese digital-signage service for creating, scheduling, and updating content across screens from one place.
summary: SwiftDisplay positions itself as simple digital signage with impact. Its official homepage describes centralized screen management, editable templates, scheduling, multi-screen content, widgets/integrations, offline playback of the last valid schedule, and compatibility paths including web browsers, Android TV, Smart TV, and computers connected to displays. It presents use cases for restaurants, clinics and health, companies, and retail, and links to a public café-menu simulator. The site is Portuguese-language; the social copy below is an English adaptation grounded only in verified public wording.

brand.name: SwiftDisplay
brand.voice: Clear, reassuring, practical, and benefit-led; the source copy emphasizes less complexity, clearer communication, guided setup, and content that stays relevant.
brand.audience: Teams and organizations communicating on digital screens, especially restaurants, clinics and health settings, companies, retail businesses, agencies, resellers, and AV/IT installers.

pages.title: SwiftDisplay · Sinalização digital
pages.text: Official homepage. The site says users can create, schedule, and update content for screens in one place. It presents use cases for restaurants, clinics and health, companies, and retail; features including centralized management, editable templates, scheduling, widgets and integrations, multi-screen content, content updates, and cached playback during network outages; device paths including web browser, Android TV, Smart TV, and a computer connected to a screen; and a public café-menu simulator link. The footer tagline is 'Mensagens que chegam mais longe.'

pages.title: Digital Signage Simulator - SwiftDisplay

pages.title: Política de Cookies - SwiftDisplay
pages.text: Official cookie policy, last updated October 2026. It says SwiftDisplay does not use advertising or third-party tracking cookies and uses technically necessary authentication session storage, localStorage, and service-worker cache; Stripe may set antifraud cookies during checkout.

No official Instagram or TikTok profile URLs were exposed in the inspected homepage, simulator page, or cookie policy; brand.instagram and brand.tiktok are therefore blank.

The linked CSS loads DM Sans, Manrope, Inter, Playfair Display, and Oswald. The active root landing-page assignment uses DM Sans for body text and Manrope for prominent headings/brand elements; other families appear in embedded product/template views.

name: SwiftCal
description: SwiftCal is a modern calendar and scheduling web application for appointments with individuals and teams. The official homepage presents integrated video, branded booking links, website embeds, automated email workflows, services and Stripe payments, Google Calendar and Microsoft Outlook integrations, team calendars, push notifications, a PWA install path, live demos, and Individual and Teams plans.
summary: SwiftCal presents itself as a clean, modern scheduling SaaS with a blue-and-orange visual system. The official homepage is in Portuguese and emphasizes effortless booking, integrated videoconferencing, automated workflows, branded booking pages, external website widgets, payment-enabled services, calendar integrations, team availability, push alerts, PWA installation, live demos, and paid Individual and Teams plans. The privacy page states that the service collects name, email, and scheduling data and uses it to provide, maintain, and improve the service and process bookings.

pages.title: SwiftCal - Seamless Scheduling

It also documents PWA installation on iOS and Android, shows three SwiftCal app screens, links to booking/profile demos, and lists Individual (€5/month) and Teams (€15/month, 3 users included plus extra-user pricing) plans, with VAT note. name: Golden Mailbox
description: Golden Mail Box is a virtual mailbox service presented from Loulé, Portugal. The official site describes receiving physical mail, photographing envelope exteriors, notifying customers digitally, and letting customers request opening and scanning, forwarding, or secure destruction.
summary: The official Portuguese and English pages position Golden Mail Box as a premium virtual mailbox for entrepreneurs, expatriates, freelancers, and businesses in Portugal. The site emphasizes a physical address in Loulé/Algarve, digital notifications, remote mail actions, GDPR/privacy language, and local operator growth. Inline CSS defines Inter for body text and the visual system uses white, navy, blue, pale blue, ink, muted slate, and orange/gold accents. No official Instagram or TikTok URL was exposed in the inspected homepage HTML.

brand.name: Golden Mail Box
brand.headingFont: Inter (the inline CSS sets body font-family to Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif; no separate heading family is declared)
brand.uppercase: Eyebrows, navigation labels, plan labels, and some UI labels use uppercase styling; body copy is sentence case.
brand.voice: Clear, reassuring, practical, privacy-conscious, and lightly premium; explain remote mail handling in direct language.
brand.audience: Entrepreneurs, expatriates, freelancers, remote founders, and companies needing a Portugal mailing address or remote mail management.
